# HalfNES

The NES emulator classes in the released Consoles JAR come from [HalfNES](https://github.com/andrew-hoffman/halfnes), which is licensed under GPL-3.0. This directory provides readable source reconstructed from the classes in that release. The upstream project and its history are at the linked repository; this reconstruction is not a byte-for-byte reproducible build.

See [GPL-3.0.txt](GPL-3.0.txt) for the license.
